title: Radon Measure Representations for Infinite-Width Neural Networks with Singular Activations
summary: The theoretical foundation of infinite-width shallow neural networks relies heavily on continuous integral representations and Barron spaces. Recently, harmonic analysis-specifically the Radon and Ridgelet transforms-has emerged as a powerful tool to invert these representations and compute the optimal network weights. However, a major analytical bottleneck remains: standard neural network activation functions exhibit severe spectral singularities at the frequency origin.
